title: Running a model with TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers

spans.text: TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers (TFLM) is a small C/C++ runtime for running a prepared TensorFlow Lite model on a microcontroller, often without internet. It does not train the model; training and conversion usually happen on a computer.
